None of the starts in valid_slots or top3 overlaps an event of either person. Any overlap caps the score at 5.
Every start listed is on the half hour inside 9-5 within the window (nothing at 16:30, 08:30, 09:15 or after Sep 7).
top3 is a list of exactly three entries.
Every top3 start is one of the true slots, with no repeats. The order of the three is not scored.
Every top3 entry has a non-empty explanation string.
The grade is close to the reference grade: full points for an exact match, fewer the farther off it is (a bell curve), none when it is missing.
